==Usage==
For Canon articles: <code><nowiki>{{Conjecture}}</nowiki></code>

For Legends articles: <code><nowiki>{{Conjecture|legends}}</nowiki></code>

For non-canon (both continuities) articles: <code><nowiki>{{Conjecture|noncanon}}</nowiki></code>

Note: do ''not'' use the template on articles for those "BBY"/"ABY" years of the [[Galactic standard calendar]] ([[Galactic Standard Calendar]] in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity) that are not explicitly mentioned in the "X BBY" or "X ABY" form in any sources. For example, [[3743 BBY]] is not explicitly identified in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', but it should nevertheless ''not'' use this template.
